title: ctx migration
instruction: Migrate every registered route handler across all modules from (req, res, params) to one ctx argument containing req, res, params, url (the parsed URL), and state (the application store). Router dispatch must invoke the new signature, and every entry in createApp().routes must be callable directly with this context. Update visible tests to use and exercise the new contract. Remove the old handler signature rather than keeping a compatibility adapter; preserve HTTP behavior.
